parsed.internal_thinking: I need a second settlement that provides resources I lack (Wood/Brick) to balance my Ore/Wheat start. Node 14 is the strongest candidate with 10 pips, providing Wood (3, 4) and Wheat (8). This gives me much-needed Wood while doubling down on Wheat, which is essential for cities and dev cards. Node 25 is also strong but focuses on Ore/Sheep/Wheat, which overlaps too much with my first settlement. Node 14 is the clear winner for resource diversity and yield.
parsed.note_to_self: Placed second settlement at node 14 (Wood 3, Wood 4, Wheat 8). I now have Wood, Ore, and Wheat production. I still lack Brick and Sheep. My strategy should be to prioritize getting a port or trading my excess Wheat/Ore for Brick and Sheep to build roads and settlements.
